visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short dark hair, wearing round-rimmed glasses and a beige sleeveless blouse, sits in a professional office environment. Behind her is a dark bookshelf, a desk lamp with a black shade, and a framed certificate on the wall. She speaks directly to the camera, using expressive hand gestures to explain skin reactions, while a large text overlay at the top asks if Retinol use causes allergy or normal reactions. (2) The camera remains static as the woman continues her explanation. Graphic text boxes in yellow and white appear intermittently, listing symptoms like redness, itching, and peeling. Her facial expressions are animated, emphasizing her points. A quick insert shot at 00:36 shows a macro close-up of a person's eye area with severe, puffy swelling to illustrate a true allergic reaction. (3) The final segment transitions to a clean white screen featuring the clinic's logo, DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC, along with contact details including a LINE ID, phone number, and physical addresses for locations in Sanchong and Zhongshan districts. A social media handle and a call-to-action 'contact us' are clearly displayed in a minimalist layout.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A clear female voice starts speaking with high clarity and a professional, informative tone. A medium-volume, upbeat electronic pop BGM begins, featuring a steady 4/4 beat and bright synth textures. The recording environment is pristine with no background noise. (2) A sharp 'ding' SFX marks the appearance of the first text box. A male voice interjects briefly at 00:23 with a high-pitched, exaggerated exclamation of surprise. This is followed by a comical sliding whistle SFX and several rhythmic 'pop' sounds that sync with the bullet points on screen. (3) The primary speaker increases her speech rate during the explanation of patient cases, maintaining high articulation. The music stays consistent in the background. A final low-frequency impact SFX and a melodic bell stinger conclude the audio track as the contact information is displayed.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Definition -> Comparison -> Solution -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide professional medical advice to skincare enthusiasts regarding the use of Vitamin A derivatives (Retinol/Retinoic Acid). It aims to clarify common misconceptions by differentiating between expected inflammatory reactions (redness/peeling) and actual allergic emergencies (swelling/oozing), ultimately promoting the services of the DRX Dermatology Clinic.
